items.title: Clooney Foundation for Justice names Gucci exclusive fashion partner for 2026 Albies
items.summary: Gucci joins as the newest Sentinel Sponsor and exclusive fashion partner for the Clooney Foundation's 2026 Albies awards, held October 9 at London's Natural History Museum alongside Charlotte Tilbury Beauty and Microsoft. Honorees include journalists and rights advocates; Graham Norton hosts with musical performances by Jackson Browne and Vic Mensa.

items.source: Esquire (via NewsNow/Esquire Australia syndication, US menswear trade angle)
items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 menswear takes preppy styling to its dark side
items.summary: Review of Demna's Spring 2027 menswear notes a shift toward 'club not collegiate': slick Miami Vice-tinged suits, cropped trousers, sockless loafers and prep-coded pieces (peacoats, horsebit-detailed trenchcoats) layered with chains and iced-out jewelry nodding to Dapper Dan, mixed with indie-sleaze darkness.

items.title: Forum members call Demna's Gucci Spring 2027 'vulgar'
items.summary: theFashionSpot forum members gave an overwhelmingly negative verdict on Demna's fifth Gucci collection, with posts calling it 'a tragedy,' 'pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision,' and 'a pile of nothingness'; several said they hoped it was his last season at the house.

items.title: 'Gucci Morty' meme coverage continues circulating on X
items.summary: Entertainment-news account post flags that 'Gucci Morty,' an Instagram-originated edit of Rick and Morty's Morty Smith in a Gucci T-shirt, has gone viral; the official Rick and Morty X account later amplified the fan meme, sustaining Gucci brand-name visibility in youth meme culture into the week of September 6 and beyond, independent of any official Gucci marketing push.

items.title: PurseForum thread debates durability of new Gucci Flora pieces under Demna
items.summary: Thread starter asks how the revived Flora print's coated canvas and silk twill compare in durability to Gucci's standard GG canvas; commenters give mixed verdicts, with one calling the floral motif 'really just a two season bag,' reflecting lingering buyer skepticism about longevity versus price even as the collection gets renewed attention.

items.title: Kering's quarter shows Gucci turnaround still incomplete
items.summary: US trade coverage of Kering's Q1 2026 results: Gucci's comparable sales fell 8% (group fashion & leather goods down 3% comparable), with North America the one bright spot at +9% while China stayed 'deeply negative,' Europe 'still weak,' and the Middle East down 11%. CFO Armelle Poulou called it 'an important first milestone and a sequential improvement' in a 'challenging and uncertain environment,' tempering optimism about a fast turnaround.

items.title: YouTube review: 'Demna Is Turning Gucci Into Something Very Strange'
items.summary: Independent fashion-critique video analyzes Demna's Spring 2027 collection and recent Gucci bag releases, arguing his direction is becoming increasingly idiosyncratic; framed as commentary rather than brand-sanctioned content, contributing to the split critical discourse around the designer's tenure. Engagement metrics (views/likes/comments) were not visible via available access.
